findings.label: Prompt injection in verify_claim
findings.detail: claim and evidence_body are f-string interpolated verbatim into the Gemini verification prompt with no sanitisation (agent.py lines 72-76). A stored draft sentence containing a newline-delimited instruction can redirect the model to reply SUPPORTED for an unsupported claim, bypassing the hallucination guard. Fix: strip/escape newlines from both inputs before interpolation, or use XML-style delimiters to separate instructions from data.

findings.label: _parse_response multi-tag sentence gap
findings.detail: The sentence regex in GeminiProvider._parse_response does not reliably handle multiple EV tags spread across lines. A tag on a new line after a sentence-terminated match may be absorbed into the next sentence's match, causing verify_claims() downstream to link evidence citations to the wrong sentence. Fix: test the regex against multi-tag, multi-line Gemini output and add a covering test case.

findings.label: admit_model.py .env parser drops quoted values
findings.detail: The inline .env loader in scripts/admit_model.py does not strip surrounding quotes from values. A .env entry like AI_PROVIDER="gemini" would be read as gemini" (trailing quote), potentially silently running admission against the template provider in CI instead of Gemini. Fix: strip surrounding quotes or use python-dotenv.
